stem: Voltmarkt's business sales team measures its sales cycle from the day a lead first filled in the website form, not from the day the opportunity was created. What does this do to its sales velocity?

options.text: Velocity is understated, since the cycle counts time before the opportunity
Velocity is overstated, since the cycle leaves out time after the opportunity
Nothing changes, since a lead and an opportunity are the same deal
Only the win rate changes, since more leads enter its denominator
